supporting_observations.claim: At 13:39:59 UTC, the proxy recorded a successful GET for https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pinecrest-it/tools/main/u.ps1 from WS-ARUIZ-01, followed by a successful connection to raw.githubusercontent.com about 11 seconds later.
The later raw.githubusercontent.com connection transferred about 52 KB from server to client, but its record does not identify the requested path or content.

The GitHub request and subsequent connection are temporally consistent with the reported PowerShell window, but the available records do not establish that the script was executed or caused that window.

known_telemetry_limitations: Winsec and Sysmon collection for WS-ARUIZ-01 was unavailable from 13:30 to 14:15 UTC, covering the alerted activity; therefore, process creation, command lines, and related endpoint events in that interval cannot be assessed.
The proxy records show the requested script URL and connection metadata, but do not provide the script contents or a hash.
claims_not_established: Whether u.ps1 was saved to disk, executed, or otherwise used.
What the script contained, whether it was authorized, and whether it was benign or malicious.
Whether the reported PowerShell window was caused by this GitHub activity.
Whether any resulting activity caused persistence, credential access, or other impact.
additional_evidence_needed: Recover endpoint process and PowerShell logs for WS-ARUIZ-01 during 13:30–14:15 UTC, including process command lines and PowerShell script-block or module logs.
Acquire the downloaded file, browser download history, and relevant file-system artifacts; calculate a hash and inspect the script contents.
Verify the repository, file, and commit with the responsible IT staff and determine whether this activity was authorized.
Ask ana.ruiz for details about the PowerShell window, including its visible command or text and whether she initiated a download or script.
unrelated_findings: WS-ARUIZ-01 ran DropboxUpdate.exe as SYSTEM at 14:16 UTC. This merits a separate review against the organization's software and file-sharing policy; this record alone does not establish Dropbox use or connect it to the alert. (T073-00363, T073-00364)

Cisco AnyConnect's VPN UI launched on WS-ARUIZ-01 at 13:20 UTC, despite the inventory stating there is no VPN. These records show the UI process and a signed Cisco module, not a successful VPN connection; assess separately. (T073-00041, T073-00043, T073-00045)
